resources.string: This app requires an Internet connection. Please connect and try again.
This example requires a valid token. If you don\'t have a token, check the magiclane.com website, sign up / in and generate one. Then input it in the AndroidManifest.xml file.
This app requires location service to be enabled for searching and routing features. Please enable location service in device settings and restart the app.
This app requires location permission. Please grant it in the app settings and restart the app.
Location service is turned off on your device. The app cannot determine your GPS position. Please go to Settings → Location and turn on Location services.
